dataList.content:
Nelly was right. Heathcliff the Erlking had already disappeared into the rooftops.
正如耐莉所言，魔王希斯克利夫消失于屋顶之上。
dataList.place:
Stairwell to the Rooftop
通往屋顶的楼梯

dataList.content:
The only chance Vergilius gave us... the awakening I managed with my clock...
维吉里乌斯给予我们的唯一的机会，还有我的钟表终于能做到的事情……

The very last of Heathcliff's hopes...
以及希斯克利夫所拥有的唯一的希望……

Yeah... It's...
这样啊……真的……

... over.
结束了。

Endless vortex of colours, mixing into a sludge.
颜色不断混合。

A splash of grey paint over the heart that once gleamed violet.
曾短暂闪耀着紫色光芒的心灵，被涂上了灰色。

A splash of bloody red paint. Splashes of faded colours.
接着被涂上血红色，又被染上黯淡的颜色……

Again and again... until there was nothing but blackness.
再然后，在不知不觉中我的颜色只剩下黑色。

Unseen by all. Unnecessary to anyone. The colour of the pitch-black night.
谁都看不见。也不需要被谁看见的黑夜之色。

The colour of the Backstreets.
后巷的颜色。

Another power outage...
又停电了……

<... Huh? Where did Heathcliff go...?>
<……嗯？希斯克利夫不见了。>

Yeah, he disappeared all of a sudden...
真的呢，希斯克利夫先生突然间去哪儿了……

What are you talking about? I'm right here.
你在说什么啊。我就在这里啊。

A predictable ending, is it not? He returned to the Backstreets. The place where our dear Heathcliff belongs.
很老套的结局吧。肯定是又回后巷里去了吧。对我们的希斯克利夫来说，没有比那更适合他的地方了。

Poor Heathcliff. Once again he turns his tail, tasting nothing but defeat and despair.
可怜的希斯克利夫。他这次也是尝到了失败和挫折之后就回去了。

Stop... stop it. I don't want to hear any more of it!
住口……住口。我不想听！

Pitiful... isn't he? He would not have changed one bit, no matter how much time he spent in your company.
可怜啊……就算和你们在一起，这孩子也没有任何改变。

Look at Heathcliff the Erlking. Heathcliff the devil.
看看那成为魔王、化身恶魔后归来的希斯克利夫吧。

The very same end that awaits Heathcliff.
那就是希斯克利夫的结局。

<I disagree. You probably can't hear a thing I'm saying... but I still do.>
<不会是那样的。不过反正这话在你耳中也不过是滴答声而已。>

<Because...>
<要说为什么……>

I'm hurting. I don't want to be here anymore.
好痛苦。我不想再呆在这里了。

... So I must marry Linton in the end.
……结果就是我必须要嫁给林顿。

dataList.content:
Because it would degrade me to marry Heathcliff now.
因为现在嫁给希斯克利夫的话，就会降低我的身份。

Oh... bloody hell. It's this memory again.
啊……妈的。又是这段记忆。

Cathy and Nelly must be talking about me in that room.
凯茜和耐莉一定正在房间里谈论着我。

Haah... I have to get out of here. If I had to stay and listen... my heart will crack and fall apart... until it completely shatters.
哈……我得赶紧出去。再听下去的话，我的心一定会支离破碎的吧。

And this bloody clock noise is back...
可是……我还是能听到那该死的钟表的声音。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Past?
呼啸山庄，过去？

dataList.content:
... It could only mean that time's passing, no matter how much I suffer.
不论我有多痛苦……时间也一直在流逝……

But... would waiting, letting time pass, change anything?
可是……这样再等下去会有什么变化吗？

What difference would it...
再等下去有什么……

Fine. I'll wait a little. So shut up and—
知道了。我再等等看。所以差不多就别再说……

Marrying Linton would give me the means to help Heathcliff. I could make him a better person.
如果我嫁给林顿，可以让希斯克利夫变得更好。

So he must never know the immense love I have for him.
所以我不能让那孩子知道我有多爱他。

No. This time...
不，这次……

I don't want to shut this open door.
我不想将那扇开着的门又关上。

I'm still scared. Terrified, even. But...
我仍然感到十分害怕。即便如此……

Cathy, I'm sorry.
凯茜，抱歉。

I've disappointed you.
我让你失望了。

Because I was too afraid to hear your true feelings.
因为我太害怕听到你的真心。

I know. This future... is a future that will never come true. Not for us.
我知道的。这个未来……是不会再降临到我们身上的未来。

I wrecked everything with my hesitation.
我的犹豫毁掉了我们的一切。

I hurt more than just us; I hurt Nelly, too.
我毁掉的不仅仅是我们……也毁掉了耐莉的一切。

I have to start... fixing the things I've wrecked.
是时候去修好……所有我毁掉的东西了。

<Because...>
<要说为什么……>

<... I don't want my Heathcliff...>
<……至少我不希望希斯克利夫……>

<... to live the rest of his life in regret.>
<在悔恨中度过余生。>

<That is why... despite everything...>
<所以……尽管如此……>

<I want Heathcliff to forge on to the rooftop.>
<我希望希斯克利夫能够向屋顶前进。>

Those flowers bloom in places like desolate moors or steep cliffsides.
那些花盛开在贫瘠的荒地或陡峭的悬崖上。
dataList.place:

dataList.content:
So they may appear more lonely than anything else in the world.
因此，它们可能比世界上其他任何东西都显得更孤独寂寞。

Do you want to know why I still love this flower the most?
你想知道我为什么仍然最爱这种花吗？

All other flowers lose their colours and fade as they wither away.
其他的花枯萎时便褪去了颜色。

But this flower... even as it withers and wilts...
但是这种花即使枯萎凋谢……

... remains the same colour.
也会保留与最初时同样的颜色。

So when you're gone, I will dry these flowers and decorate my room with them.
所以当你不在的时候，我会把这些花晾干挂在我的房间里。

Uh... what, like make rings of them flowers? Don't say something so foolish.
呃……拿去做戒指吗？……别说傻话了。

Why would I ever leave you?
我怎么可能丢下你一个人离开呢？

dataList.content:
So stupid...
真傻……

I never once realized what she meant by those words.
直到此刻，我才真正理解这句话的意思。

Everything you've ever said, Catherine... was an expression of love.
凯瑟琳，你说的每一句话……都是对我传达的爱意。

Oi, I'm back.
我，回来了。

<Heathcliff!>
<希斯克利夫！>

dataList.content:
Where the hell did you go? You blipped out of existence when the lightning struck, and...
你去哪里了？闪电一落下来你就突然消失了……

Are you okay, Heathcliff?
你还好吗，希斯克利夫先生？

No. It hurts. It still hurts like hell. But...
不。还是很痛苦……痛苦得不得了。但是……

I will move past you and make my way to the rooftop, Nelly.
我会丢下你，再去到屋顶上，耐莉。

... You're... what?
……什么？

Heathcliff the Erlking will not be my future.
魔王希斯克利夫，那家伙不会是我的未来。

You, him... you both had access to every knowledge, but made the same choices anyway.
你和那家伙明明知道这一切，但仍然做出了相同的选择。

Not me. I'm going to make a different choice.
但我不同。我会做出别的选择。

... Thank you so much for looking after us, Nelly. It must have been very hard.
……谢谢你一直以来都在照顾我们。耐莉。

Among the three individuals mentioned in Miss Catherine's will...
于凯瑟琳小姐遗嘱中提及的三位人物。

Since Hindley and Linton are now both clearly deceased...
其中，亨德利与埃德加显然已经死亡……

... it can be said that, at least on paper, the ownership of Wuthering Heights has been transferred to Heathcliff.
理论上，呼啸山庄的实际所有者很可能已经是希斯克利夫先生了。

I'll give you a new future, Nelly. I'll give you freedom.
我会给你想要的，自由的未来。

So start writing as you will.
所以去随心所欲地书写它吧。

Write your own tale. Or whatever else it is that you wish to do.
无论是你自己的故事还是别的什么。

With that, Heathcliff left Nelly behind and began making his way to the rooftop.
说罢，希斯克利夫丢下了耐莉，转身向屋顶走去。

Nelly collapsed to the floor, making an odd noise that sounded like a mixture of laughter and sobbing.
在他背后，耐莉带着似哭似笑的腔调，吐出我难以辨认的话语。

I'm... free to go...? I've been... freed? Then I... I can finally...
我自由了……我自由了吗？那么我也……终于我也……

The hell are you lot doing down there, faffin' about? Come on up.
你在干嘛？赶紧跟上来啊。

<For the first time... I really have no idea what you're thinking right now.>
<我真不知道你现在在想些什么。这好像是我第一次这么觉得。>

Thinking?
想什么？

I don't really 'think' that hard, mate.
你觉得我在认真思考吗？

I just clearly know what I have to do.
我只是……明确地知道自己该做什么了而已。

That's all.
仅此而已。
